entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Mi marchi, en berá, ma criabus ma criamá tachi âun. Mi marchi empera mach mi quema quinupineabua mu truâ, paratani quinú émpera patabarabia. Tachi sese audubua, care facia pea bodota tachi sese ituba bua.
